title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Comprehensive information regarding our architectural processes, service details, and working principles.

architectural.q: How much does an architectural project cost?
architectural.a: It varies based on square meters, complexity, and scope. Typically 50-150 TL per m² for residential projects. We offer free preliminary consultation for detailed quotes.

architectural.q: How long does the architectural design process take?
architectural.a: For an average residential project, from concept to permit projects takes 2-4 months. Expedited programs can be arranged for urgent cases.

architectural.q: What projects are needed to obtain permits?
architectural.a: Architectural, structural, electrical, mechanical, landscape, and fire safety projects are required. We coordinate all engineering disciplines for complete documentation.

architectural.q: Do you design according to earthquake regulations?
architectural.a: Yes, all our projects are designed according to current Turkish Building Earthquake Code (TBDY 2018) in collaboration with structural engineers.

architectural.q: Is 3D visualization included in the price?
architectural.a: Yes, all packages include minimum 3 photorealistic 3D renders as standard. Additional renders are charged separately.

architectural.q: Which cities do you serve?
architectural.a: Our office is in Ankara, but we provide architectural services throughout Turkey and internationally through online collaboration.

architectural.q: Do you serve buildings under urban transformation?
architectural.a: Yes, we are experienced in demolition, new projects, and permits for buildings identified as risky under Urban Transformation Law.

architectural.q: How can I learn the zoning status?
architectural.a: If you provide your land's block/parcel information, we can query current zoning status and report your building rights.

architectural.q: Is it reasonable to demolish and rebuild an old building?
architectural.a: This decision depends on structure condition and zoning rights. We provide feasibility reports for the most economical solution.

architectural.q: What is a concept project and why is it important?
architectural.a: Concept project determines the general form, plan scheme, and architectural character. Detail design begins after your approval.

architectural.q: Do we have revision rights?
architectural.a: 3 main revision rounds are free during concept phase. Additional revisions are subject to extra charge.

architectural.q: Can I get only design service?
architectural.a: Yes, we offer partial services like concept design only or permit project only.

architectural.q: Do you provide soil survey and mapping services?
architectural.a: We coordinate soil analysis, surveying, and cadastral processing through our solution partners.

architectural.q: Do you design energy-efficient (Green Building)?
architectural.a: Yes, sustainability is our core principle. We use passive design strategies, solar energy, and proper insulation details.

architectural.q: Do you work on commercial projects besides villas?
architectural.a: Yes, we are experienced in commercial and public projects like offices, restaurants, stores, hotels, hospitals, and educational buildings.

architectural.q: Do you also do landscape design?
architectural.a: Building-environment relationship is important to us. Garden arrangement and landscape design are parts of our architectural project.

architectural.q: Do you integrate smart home systems into projects?
architectural.a: With our technology partner, we integrate lighting, HVAC, and security systems from the beginning of design.

architectural.q: Do you work on international projects?
architectural.a: Yes, we work on international projects through online meetings and local partners. We adapt standards to relevant countries.

architectural.q: Can I renovate in a conservation area?
architectural.a: Conservation Board permission is required in conservation areas. We manage this process on your behalf.

architectural.q: Do you design Tiny Houses?
architectural.a: Yes, we design minimal living spaces, modular structures, and tourism-purpose bungalow facilities.

interior.q: What is the interior design project fee?
interior.a: Varies by square meters and service scope. Typically 80-200 TL per m² for residences, different pricing for commercial spaces.

interior.q: How long does renovation take?
interior.a: Average 3+1 apartment renovation takes 45-60 days. Decoration-only changes complete in 20-30 days.

interior.q: Where do you source furniture?
interior.a: We produce custom pieces in our own workshop and use quality products from trusted suppliers.

interior.q: Do you renovate wet areas (bathroom/kitchen)?
interior.a: Yes, we provide complete bathroom and kitchen renovation including plumbing renewal, tiling, and cabinet installation.

interior.q: Can we live in the house during renovation?
interior.a: No for comprehensive renovations (demolition). Yes for furniture-only changes.

interior.q: Do you design according to my budget?
interior.a: We determine your budget in the first meeting and make material/furniture selections accordingly.

interior.q: Do we select materials together?
interior.a: Yes, we take you to showrooms to select all materials together by touch and sight.

interior.q: Is lighting design included in the service?
interior.a: Yes, space-specific lighting calculation and fixture selection are standard services.

interior.q: Do you design just one room?
interior.a: Yes, we provide services for singular spaces like living room, kitchen, or bedroom only.

interior.q: Can I use my existing furniture?
interior.a: Absolutely. We integrate your valued furniture into the new design.

interior.q: Do you design offices?
interior.a: Yes, we design office projects focused on employee efficiency, acoustic comfort, and corporate identity.

interior.q: Do you have experience in store/restaurant design?
interior.a: Yes, we specialize in creating spatial identity suitable for your brand's target audience.

interior.q: Do you install gypsum board suspended ceilings?
interior.a: Yes, we install illuminated suspended ceilings, hidden lighting, and acoustic ceiling applications.

interior.q: Do you recommend flooring for underfloor heating?
interior.a: We recommend porcelain tiles, stone, or compatible laminate flooring for underfloor heating.

interior.q: Which do you recommend: double or triple glazing?
interior.a: Depending on climate zone and needs, we recommend low-E double glazing or sound-insulated triple glazing.

interior.q: I received unpainted delivery, what should I do?
interior.a: We offer complete package service including painting, plastering, floor covering, and plumbing infrastructure.

interior.q: Can I get consultancy before buying a home?
interior.a: Yes, 'Pre-Purchase Consultancy' evaluates the home's potential and renovation costs.

interior.q: Do you have online design service?
interior.a: Yes, with 'E-Design' package, we prepare layout plans and moodboards remotely.

interior.q: Do you help with color selection?
interior.a: We offer color palette suggestions based on space lighting and psychological effects.

interior.q: Do you provide acoustic solutions?
interior.a: We prepare acoustic arrangement projects especially for offices, meeting rooms, and home theaters.

adaptive_reuse.a: Converting an existing building from its original function to a different use, such as transforming an old factory into an office.

adaptive_reuse.q: What types of buildings can you repurpose?
adaptive_reuse.a: We convert abandoned structures like old factories, warehouses, barns, inns, schools into modern offices, residences, galleries, and cafes.

adaptive_reuse.q: Do you do historical building restoration?
adaptive_reuse.a: Yes, we draw restoration and survey projects for protected historical buildings with Conservation Board permission.

adaptive_reuse.q: Can old buildings be structurally strengthened?
adaptive_reuse.a: We offer earthquake strengthening and structural reinforcement. We prepare strengthening projects with structural engineers.
Measuring and drawing all details of existing structure. It's the fundamental document for restoration and renovation projects.
Yes, we specialize in converting high-ceiling industrial structures into modern living spaces.

adaptive_reuse.q: Do you design SOHO (Small Office Home Office) concepts?
adaptive_reuse.a: Yes, we design flexible spaces for home-office combined use.
Attic or roof floor creation is possible depending on zoning and ceiling height. Municipality permission required.

adaptive_reuse.q: Can I convert basement to living space?
adaptive_reuse.a: Basements can be converted to habitable areas with moisture insulation, ventilation, and lighting solutions.

adaptive_reuse.q: Can an old house be converted to apartments?
adaptive_reuse.a: If zoning allows multi-unit buildings, conversion to apartments is possible by establishing condominium rights.

adaptive_reuse.q: Can I convert commercial to residential?
adaptive_reuse.a: Use change requires municipality permission. Conversion is possible if zoning plan allows.

adaptive_reuse.q: What can be done with registered cultural heritage buildings?
adaptive_reuse.a: No intervention without Conservation Board decision on registered buildings. We do restoration per Board decision.

adaptive_reuse.q: Do you design in industrial style?
adaptive_reuse.a: Yes, we create unique spaces using industrial design elements like brick-concrete and exposed pipes.
Yes, we provide architectural design and structural calculations for modular container structures.

adaptive_reuse.q: Is there cost advantage in adaptive reuse?
adaptive_reuse.a: Can be 20-40% more economical than new construction. Also environmentally friendly in terms of sustainability.

turnkey.q: Do you build steel construction houses?

implementation.q: Is implementation project different from permit project?
implementation.a: Yes, permit project is for municipality approval, implementation project is for site production.

implementation.q: Can only implementation project be commissioned?
implementation.a: Yes, if concept and permit projects are ready, we can provide only implementation project service.

implementation.q: What is the implementation project fee?
implementation.a: Approximately 60-80% of permit project fee. Varies by square meters and detail level.

implementation.q: How is building approach value calculated?
implementation.a: Construction square meters x unit m² cost = estimated approach value.

implementation.q: Is structural implementation project also drawn?
